maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue from new wellheads and pressure control equipment sold for new wells (SafeDrill); smaller share from rentals and service.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas exploration and production companies drilling and completing wells.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through own manufacturing and product sales; the notable deal was the Baker Hughes surface pressure control acquisition.

mission_critical.reason: Wellheads are safety-critical, API 6A-qualified pressure control equipment; switching risks well-control issues and rig downtime.
